title: Query Pipeline
prompt:
Write `createQuery(records)` that RETURNS a function `query(opts)`. Each record has `{ id, score }`. `opts` may contain:

- `minScore`, `maxScore` — inclusive score range; missing bounds are ignored
- `sortBy` — `"score"` (default) or `"id"`
- `order` — `"asc"` (default) or `"desc"`; ties keep original order
- `page` (1-based, default 1), `perPage` (default 2)

`query` RETURNS `{ items, total, page, pages }` where `items` is the current page of results (empty array when the page is out of range) and `pages` is `Math.ceil(total / perPage)` (0 when there are no results).

tests.name: filters by the inclusive score range
tests.hint: Filter first: keep records where each present bound is satisfied with <= and >=.

tests.name: sorts by field and order, stably
tests.hint: Sort a copy — compare values, flip the sign for desc, and break ties with the original index.

tests.name: paginates and reports pages
tests.hint: Slice with (page - 1) * perPage; pages is Math.ceil(total / perPage) but 0 for an empty set.
